latest_release.name: `tokscale@v4.22.1` is here!
latest_release.body:
[![Tokscale](https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/raw/main/.github/assets/hero-v3.png)](https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale) # `tokscale@v4.22.1` is here!
- Count archived OpenClaw SQLite usage without double-counting live transcripts. - Keep Antigravity quota discovery working across resumed sessions and stale environments. - Isolate mismatched Cursor refresh grants and redact OAuth tokens in debug output. - Ignore invalid TUI color overrides instead of crashing. - Faster web pages, smaller profile payloads, and refreshed benchmark and Capital data. ## What's Changed * feat(frontend): pin the home page's featured profile to a chosen account by @junhoyeo in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1628 * feat(capital): bring the ledger, capex and benchmark data up to November 12, 2026 by @junhoyeo in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1629 * feat(capital): add general financings by Microsoft, Alphabet, Oracle, Akamai and Vistra by @junhoyeo in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1631 * feat(benchmarks): read Terminal-Bench 4.1 and refresh its snapshot by @junhoyeo in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1632 * fix(usage): redact Cursor OAuth tokens in auth struct Debug output by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1623 * fix(usage): keep foreign Cursor refresh tokens isolated by @0xvectr in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1624 * fix(tui): reject non-hex config colors instead of panicking on a multi-byte character by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1627 * fix(openclaw): count archived SQLite transcript usage by @vincentkoc in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1633 * fix(usage): sync Antigravity session across lifecycle hooks and active environments by @azestkingscrown in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1630 * fix(usage): persist only verified Antigravity environment sessions by @junhoyeo in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1635 * fix(cursor): reject mismatched database refresh grants by @junhoyeo in https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/pull/1634 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale/compare/v4.22.0...v4.22.1
